label: Review and integration
title: Review and integration of the October 2026 gathering branches
summary: Thirteen unmerged pull requests from 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-08 were checked, their headline claims recomputed with separate code, and combined into one branch based on main. Every recomputation agrees with the notes, including an imported 88-rule census that previously had no code in the repository.
takeaway: No scientific conclusion changed. The asymptotic-closure corridor page and the full-line jet autonomy note should be read more modestly than their original titles, and the entry pages are short again.
